operators: SiLU as Neg Exp Add Div
reference_evaluator: Unmodified ONNX ReferenceEvaluator and standard opset24 operators; checked isolated ONNX models.
native_chain: Original native operations only, with bit-level Interpreter control and source coefficient hashes before/after.
capture_policy: Largest original-tolerance ratio per operator retains native input values, strides, scalar attributes and native/ONNX outputs. Artifacts only; no arrays or weights in Git.
comparison_scope: Each ONNX primitive uses exactly the current native node inputs; no accumulated ONNX errors are injected into downstream native nodes.
